# CopyWeave

> Edit the words. Keep the design. A local-first, framework-agnostic copy editor with zero browser runtime dependencies.

The source checkout and release tarball contain the implementation/tests below. A dependency install is a consumer surface; do not assume its parent project installed CopyWeave's development dependencies.

## Start

- Release-candidate status: npm may return 404 until the owner completes `docs/RELEASE.md`; from source use `npm ci && npm run check`.
- Install after publication: `npm install copyweave`
- Mark durable text leaves: `data-copy-id="hero.title"`
- Mount: `createCopyWeave({siteId, pageId, activation: "query"})`
- Create content: `npx copyweave init <root> --site-id <id>`
- Edit/save: `npx copyweave serve <built-root>`
- Verify: `npx copyweave doctor <root> --strict --json`

## Contracts

- Public API: `src/types.ts`, README Browser API
- Content schema: `schema/copyweave.schema.json`
- CLI: `bin/copyweave.mjs`, README CLI
- Invariants: `AGENTS.md`
- Architecture: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- Integration recipes: `docs/INTEGRATION.md`
- Security: `docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md`
- Limitations: README Honest limitations
- Agent workflow: `skill/copyweave-integrator/SKILL.md`

## Rules for agents

- Prefer semantic `data-copy-id`; automatic IDs are migration-only.
- Do not redesign, replace typography, or alter normal page interaction.
- Never claim project save without HTTP disk confirmation.
- Keep copy plain text and preserve valid content on every failure.
- Run `npm run check`, then visually verify closed/open editor states on desktop and mobile.
